name: 3DGS Custom Initialization from Point Cloud/Mesh
aliases: 3DGS Model Learning Initialization from Point Cloud/Mesh
Custom Initialisation for 3DGS from Point Cloud/Mesh
definition: A method to initialise 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) learning by using known points from an existing 3D point cloud or mesh as the initial centres of the splats, ensuring the resulting model aligns with the original geometry and avoids 'floater' artifacts.
summary: This method initializes 3D Gaussian Splatting using dense point clouds or meshes as geometric priors, yielding cleaner models and faster convergence than standard sparse initialization.
